svg.title: Alberta training images
svg.desc: Two training images of five categories. Both have the same layered cover of overburden, Devonian and Athabasca Group over basement gneiss; the first puts granitoid in steep bands along azimuth 315, the second in rounded bodies.
svg.text: Alberta training images, hole-group split: two labelled priors that share the cover
Authored from the training holes (cover thicknesses, granitoid share); interpretations, not observed geology. 250 m cells, 10 m layers.
